title: ai-slop team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/ai-slop.yaml, the team layer of the ai-slop plugin (ADR 0064, ADR 0075). The same keys are valid in docs/conventions/ai-slop.local.yaml (the personal layer) and in the user-global layer, $HOME/.claude/ai-slop.json. Every key is optional; an absent key keeps the shipped default. Reader: skills/audit/scripts/detect.sh through skills/audit/scripts/lib/cascade-read.sh.

thresholds.description: Per-1000-word density at or above which a density rule reports a file.

ai_vocabulary.description: rule-ai-vocabulary density threshold; the shipped default is 3.0.

copulative_avoidance.description: rule-copulative-avoidance density threshold; the shipped default is 4.0.

em_dash_allowed_paths.description: Globs whose files decline rule-em-dash; the older spelling of rule_allowed_paths.rule-em-dash, merged into it. Replaces the lower layer's list whole.

rule_allowed_paths.description: Rule slug to the globs whose files decline that one rule. A higher layer's entry replaces that slug only; an empty list clears it.

excluded_paths.description: Globs whose files the audit does not scan. Replaces the lower layer's list whole.

disabled_rules.description: Rule slugs switched off for the whole repository. Replaces the lower layer's list whole.

vocab_add.description: Words added to the rule-ai-vocabulary list.

vocab_remove.description: Words removed from the rule-ai-vocabulary list.

phrase_add.description: Extended-regex fragments added to the rule-model-era-phrases roster.

phrase_remove.description: Shipped rule-model-era-phrases fragments removed, written exactly as shipped.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example audit); an entry beats this file's verification value.
